name: Thaumaturgy (Mastery of the Mortal Shell) — 1 Basic — Contortion

system.description: With a successful Physical Challenge to touch a limb, the thaumaturge causes wracking spasms; a warped arm or leg becomes unusable and grants the target the Negative Physical Trait Lame. Affecting the head instead requires winning two additional Simple Challenges after the initial touch, causing total loss of speech and a three-Trait penalty on Social Challenges from facial spasms. The thaumaturge may also cast this on herself, gaining two Traits to resist being broken free of a bite or choke hold. Effects last one scene.
